complete_old_body_units.old_text: ## The base
complete_old_body_units.disposition: Retained byte-for-byte at accepted prior head; no rule, figure, example, gap, source or CTA moved into new Guide.

complete_old_body_units.old_text: **Choose and document the legal form.** A one-person company has an individual as both sole shareholder and sole director and excludes a company as sole shareholder under the Act’s definition. A single-member private company and this defined one-person company are not interchangeable labels. State-owned companies follow the public-company provisions subject to a gazetted exemption. Shareholder liability is not simply zero: section 72 preserves unpaid shares, recoverable distributions, liabilities expressly in the constitution and calls. [Companies Act 2, 23, 26, 72](https://www.icam.mw/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/Companies-Act-No-15-of-2013-150dpi.pdf).
complete_old_body_units.disposition: Retained byte-for-byte at accepted prior head; no rule, figure, example, gap, source or CTA moved into new Guide.

complete_old_body_units.old_text: **Build the incorporation file.** Use the prescribed application signed by every applicant. Attach director/secretary consent and non-disqualification declarations; each proposed shareholder’s consent to the class, number and consideration for shares; any agent’s written authority; a reservation notice if any; and the required certified memorandum where proposed. For a guarantee company, obtain each member’s consent and stated contribution undertaking, including the statutory former-member period and pre-cessation debts. Record applicant identities and addresses, directors’ present/former names and residential addresses, business occupations/public-company directorships, shareholders and consideration, company type, registered office, prescribed information, and the one-person nominee details where applicable. The applicant declares truth and correctness. [Companies Act 28(1)–(4)](https://www.icam.mw/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/Companies-Act-No-15-of-2013-150dpi.pdf).
complete_old_body_units.disposition: Retained byte-for-byte at accepted prior head; no rule, figure, example, gap, source or CTA moved into new Guide.

complete_old_body_units.old_text: **Separate acceptance from application.** After compliance and the prescribed fee, the Registrar enters the company, allocates its number and issues the incorporation certificate. The certificate is conclusive evidence of incorporation requirements and the stated incorporation date; the registered company is a body corporate until removal. A filed document does not by itself create a presumption that its contents are correct. [Companies Act 6(8), 29–32](https://www.icam.mw/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/Companies-Act-No-15-of-2013-150dpi.pdf).
complete_old_body_units.disposition: Retained byte-for-byte at accepted prior head; no rule, figure, example, gap, source or CTA moved into new Guide.

complete_old_body_units.old_text: **Keep capital and ownership records accurately.** Section 30’s statement identifies share numbers, each class’s rights and numbers, applicable legacy nominal amounts, and paid/unpaid amounts. New shares under 87(1) have no face value: consideration per share is not a statutory nominal amount. Transferability follows the constitution under 86. Private companies are exempt from the section 145 share register, but 144 still requires proper records of shares/debentures issued and transferred. A proper transfer instrument is required, subject to transmission by operation of law; the company registers a lodged transfer or notifies refusal with reasons. [Companies Act 30, 65, 86–87, 137–138, 144–145](https://www.icam.mw/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/Companies-Act-No-15-of-2013-150dpi.pdf).
complete_old_body_units.disposition: Retained byte-for-byte at accepted prior head; no rule, figure, example, gap, source or CTA moved into new Guide.

complete_old_body_units.old_text: **Adopt and maintain the constitution.** The memorandum/articles bind the company and members subject to the Act. If none are filed, the prescribed model is deemed adopted. Do not invent the model’s contents without reading the actual regulations. Check name availability, prohibited/consent-required names and the relevant suffix; a reservation does not entitle the applicant to registration. Maintain at least one office in Malawi and file changes to its particulars. Public companies require a secretary; the reproduced private-secretary wording in 68(1) contains a double negative, so no unconditional exemption is adopted here. [Companies Act 33–35, 45–50, 55, 68, 223](https://www.icam.mw/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/Companies-Act-No-15-of-2013-150dpi.pdf).
complete_old_body_units.disposition: Retained byte-for-byte at accepted prior head; no rule, figure, example, gap, source or CTA moved into new Guide.

complete_old_body_units.old_text: **Director checks remain substantive.** Obtain written consent and certification of non-disqualification, then test the full eligibility provisions, including natural-person rules, minimum age, public-company age exception, bankruptcy, prohibition, capacity and constitutional qualifications. Do not treat a passport or local address alone as approval. [Companies Act 164–166](https://www.icam.mw/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/Companies-Act-No-15-of-2013-150dpi.pdf).
complete_old_body_units.disposition: Retained byte-for-byte at accepted prior head; no rule, figure, example, gap, source or CTA moved into new Guide.

complete_old_body_units.old_text: **Retain the tax handoff.** Identify the actual legal taxpayer, existing TIN, identity evidence and prescribed supporting documents. A business becoming potentially liable applies under 21; one nontransferable TIN is used across tax laws, and true identity/no existing TIN condition issuance. Use it on tax claims, notices, returns and statements. Company incorporation is not VAT enrolment or employer registration: route the separate scope to [VAT](mw-vat-gst.md), [payroll/social](mw-payroll-social.md) and [company tax](mw-corporate-income-tax.md). [TAA 21–23](https://elibrary.rat.gov.mw/server/api/core/bitstreams/42eb322b-f2a9-48b9-baaf-01c2ade040f5/content).

complete_old_body_units.old_text: The Registrar can require a default to be made good within 14 days of notice under 17; failure refers to the prevailing penalty schedule. complete_old_body_units.old_text: ## Cross-border points
complete_old_body_units.disposition: Retained byte-for-byte at accepted prior head; no rule, figure, example, gap, source or CTA moved into new Guide.

complete_old_body_units.old_text: A foreign company with a place of business or carrying on business in Malawi falls within Part XV. The statute lists activities that alone do not constitute carrying on business, including holding a bank account and the narrowly conditioned isolated transaction. This company-law test is not the tax permanent-establishment test. [Companies Act 357–358](https://www.icam.mw/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/Companies-Act-No-15-of-2013-150dpi.pdf).
complete_old_body_units.disposition: Retained byte-for-byte at accepted prior head; no rule, figure, example, gap, source or CTA moved into new Guide.

complete_old_body_units.old_text: Within 30 days after establishing a place or starting business, 360 requires authenticated incorporation/constitutional documents, directors’ list, applicable local-board powers, service authority for at least two persons resident in Malawi, not including a foreign company, local-office notice and agents’ declaration. Provide the executing agent’s authority where required; the Registrar can require authenticated English translations. The foreign office must be publicly accessible at least four hours on each day other than Saturday, Sunday or a public holiday. Changes in the listed particulars are generally filed within 30 days. Annual financial statements and the notice of Malawi business particulars are separate obligations, subject to ministerial exceptions. [Companies Act 360–366](https://www.icam.mw/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/Companies-Act-No-15-of-2013-150dpi.pdf).

complete_old_body_units.old_text: For a nonresident without a fixed place of business who is required to register for tax, TAA 28(2) requires a representative taxpayer in Malawi. That does not replace the company-law agents or establish treaty residence. Use [cross-border tax](mw-cross-border-tax.md) for the separate source/nonresident/credit working paper. [TAA 28(2)](https://elibrary.rat.gov.mw/server/api/core/bitstreams/42eb322b-f2a9-48b9-baaf-01c2ade040f5/content).

complete_old_body_units.old_text: **Decision: qualify the private member count.** Assume 49 separate members and one jointly held shareholding of two people, no other memberships, and the section 23 public-offer prohibition. The statutory count is 50, within the cap; counting the joint holders separately gives 51 and wrongly rejects the form. The count does not establish the other incorporation conditions. [Companies Act 23(1)–(2), 63](https://www.icam.mw/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/Companies-Act-No-15-of-2013-150dpi.pdf).
complete_old_body_units.disposition: Retained byte-for-byte at accepted prior head; no rule, figure, example, gap, source or CTA moved into new Guide.

```oa-check
name: Joint holders counted once for private membership
inputs:
  separate_members: 49
  joint_groups: 1
  persons_in_joint_group: 2
  cap: 50
steps:
  statutory_members: separate_members + joint_groups
  wrong_person_count: separate_members + persons_in_joint_group
  statutory_headroom: cap - statutory_members
  wrong_excess: wrong_person_count - cap
expected:
  statutory_members: 50
  wrong_person_count: 51
  statutory_headroom: 0
  wrong_excess: 1
```

complete_old_body_units.old_text: **Decision: no-par issue consideration, not nominal capital.** Assume a newly incorporated company after commencement, equal ordinary rights and agreed consideration of K1,000 on each of 150 shares, with K120,000 received. The unpaid K30,000 must remain visible in the statement and shareholder-liability review. It is wrong to call the paid K120,000 the whole agreed amount or to label K1,000 a statutory face value. This replaces the former purely hypothetical nominal-share arithmetic; it sets no minimum capital or fee. [Companies Act 30, 72, 87](https://www.icam.mw/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/Companies-Act-No-15-of-2013-150dpi.pdf).

complete_old_body_units.old_text: Start with tax-adjusted taxable income, not turnover. If common expenditure cannot be directly attributed, the deductible share is common expenditure multiplied by taxable income divided by total income. If that formula gives an unreasonable result, the Commissioner General may approve or direct another apportionment method. Apply those restrictions before using the adjusted taxable-income input. Act 3/2026 s 4 also inserts section 45(l) into the deductions-not-allowed provision: add back any levy payable under the Taxation Act or any other written law. 1. **Identify residence and PE separately.** The principal Act’s inclusive residence definition includes Malawi-incorporated companies and Malawi-law trusts, estates and partnerships, as well as the stated individual presence test. A PE includes an office or other fixed place through which business activity is carried on. Do not turn this inclusive statutory text into an exhaustive treaty PE/residence rule or infer a treaty day-count threshold. [Taxation Act 2](https://elibrary.rat.gov.mw/server/api/core/bitstreams/06b35bf5-faa2-4fa1-81f7-af650cce4dff/content).
2. **Determine the source, rather than the bank location.** Section 11 includes cash/noncash amounts and capital gains from actual or deemed Malawi sources, excluding exempt income from assessable income. Section 27(1)(a) covers services/work in carrying on trade in Malawi irrespective of payer residence or payment place. Section 27(1)(d) covers remuneration for services/work wherever done when the payer may claim, or otherwise would claim, a deduction connected with a Malawi PE. Section 27(5) separately deems amounts incurred, claimed or claimable in connection with a Malawi PE to have a Malawi source regardless of recipient residence/payment place. [Taxation Act 11, 27(1)(a),(d),(5)](https://elibrary.rat.gov.mw/server/api/core/bitstreams/06b35bf5-faa2-4fa1-81f7-af650cce4dff/content).
3. **Keep other source categories distinct.** Dividends attributable to taxable income of a Malawi-incorporated company are deemed Malawi-source under 27(4); PE/Malawi-held foreign-currency gains/losses under 27(6); Malawi tangible-property gains/losses and interests in Malawi-incorporated companies under 27(7). Pensions have the wholly-outside-service exclusion and proportionate-service rule in 27(1)(b); government/local-authority/statutory-corporation service abroad has the sole-purpose residence condition in 27(1)(c). Do not route every foreign receipt to a universal worldwide-income tax. [Taxation Act 27](https://elibrary.rat.gov.mw/server/api/core/bitstreams/06b35bf5-faa2-4fa1-81f7-af650cce4dff/content).
4. **Apply the nonresident gate before multiplying.** Section 76A(1) requires nonresidence, Malawi source and no attribution to the recipient’s Malawi PE. Its stated exclusions cover First Schedule exempt income/amounts and pension or annuity payments. The pension exclusion is from this tax, not proof that every pension is exempt from all income tax. For PE-attributable company income, use the separate [corporate tax Guide](mw-corporate-income-tax.md), including its currentness hold. [Taxation Act 76A](https://elibrary.rat.gov.mw/server/api/core/bitstreams/06b35bf5-faa2-4fa1-81f7-af650cce4dff/content).
5. **Do not revive the foreign-company surcharge.** Act 14/2025 s 3 deletes the additional 5% provisos for companies not incorporated in Malawi and specified nonresident taxpayers from Eleventh Schedule (c)/(d). That deletion is distinct from the later large-company additional tax, MAT and sector rules. Read the owning corporate job; no universal 35% foreign-company rate is inferred here. [Act 14/2025 s 3](https://elibrary.rat.gov.mw/server/api/core/bitstreams/fb807c0f-1335-442a-a1ce-9d6644186525/content); [Act 36/2025 ss 3–6](https://elibrary.rat.gov.mw/server/api/core/bitstreams/f9c5b41b-5dce-4764-b7c2-923c808bda48/content); [Act 3/2026 s 12](https://media.malawilii.org/media/legislation/15519/source_file/2e96ab6e73cdf961/mw-act-2026-3-publication-document.pdf).
6. **Calculate credits only after eligibility and inclusion.** For an applicable agreement allowing foreign tax as credit, 123 reduces domestic tax by the permitted credit, capped by its formula and total-tax ceiling. Foreign tax later adjusted can require a corresponding relief adjustment. For no-agreement relief, 124 applies to a person in Malawi, or a person outside Malawi deemed to derive Malawi-source income under 27(1)(c), and requires tax on the same income in the source country, proof to the Commissioner and a request; it applies the 123(3) limits. Do not give a credit merely because tax was withheld overseas. [Taxation Act 123–124](https://elibrary.rat.gov.mw/server/api/core/bitstreams/06b35bf5-faa2-4fa1-81f7-af650cce4dff/content).

Those full computations and the rent cross-reference printed as section 19(3)(a), rather than the newly inserted 18A, are unresolved here. The non-employment example assumes neither category is present. [Act 3/2026 ss 3,13](https://media.malawilii.org/media/legislation/15519/source_file/2e96ab6e73cdf961/mw-act-2026-3-publication-document.pdf).
